alice-springs-1.name: Alice Springs Desert Park
alice-springs-1.bio: Desert wildlife park with a nocturnal house, free-flying bird shows and Aboriginal-guided talks, seven kilometres from town.
alice-springs-1.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 208044427 tourism=zoo (park precinct centre), within 250 m of Wikipedia and the median of 56 geotagged Commons files; MEDIUM. Tourism NT says the park is 7 km from the centre; the pin is about 5 km in a straight line, so it is west of town and consistent.
alice-springs-1.notes: Adult day entry 41.50 (official site via search snippet, valid to 31 Mar 2027; Tourism NT lists from 39.50). Closed 25 Dec. Nocturnal tour is a separate ticket. Placement point (-23.7065,133.8325) was a 4-decimal Wikipedia point 230 m off; replaced.

alice-springs-2.name: Alice Springs Telegraph Station
alice-springs-2.bio: Best-preserved stop on the 1872 Overland Telegraph Line, with restored stone buildings, a post office and walking trails.
alice-springs-2.hours: Reserve 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM; heritage precinct to 4:00 PM
alice-springs-2.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 2345481329 tourism=information (Telegraph Station Admission Center), 120 m from Wikipedia (-23.672,133.888); MEDIUM.
alice-springs-2.notes: Entry fee 16.50 adult applies to the heritage precinct only (official site via search snippet); the reserve and trails are free to walk. Closed 25-26 Dec and 1 Jan. NT residents free with ID.

alice-springs-3.name: Araluen Cultural Precinct
alice-springs-3.bio: Arts centre galleries, the Central Australian Aviation Museum and Central Craft, in a precinct two kilometres west of town.
alice-springs-3.hours: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM daily Mar–Oct; closed Mondays Nov–Feb
alice-springs-3.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 257906834 tourism=museum (Araluen Arts Centre building), 9 m from Wikipedia (-23.70155,133.86257); HIGH.
alice-springs-3.notes: Adult 8 covers the galleries and the Central Australian Aviation Museum; Central Craft gallery is free. Nov-Feb: Tue-Sat 10-4, Sun 10-2, closed Mon. Closed Good Friday and two weeks over Christmas. The Museum of Central Australia is closed and is not mentioned.

alice-springs-4.name: Anzac Hill
alice-springs-4.bio: Hilltop war memorial and lookout over Alice Springs and the MacDonnell Ranges, a short walk or drive from town.
alice-springs-4.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 3020052368 natural=peak and node 300759105 tourism=viewpoint (within 10 m), and the median of 15 geotagged Commons files (12 m); HIGH.
alice-springs-4.notes: Arrernte name Untyeyetwelye. Hours not stated by any source; open-access hilltop memorial.

alice-springs-5.name: Emily Gap
alice-springs-5.bio: Sacred Arrernte gap east of town with a rock painting of the caterpillar dreaming, reached by a short walk.
alice-springs-5.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 879931111 tourism=viewpoint (Emily Gap), identical to Wikipedia (-23.7388,133.951); HIGH.
alice-springs-5.notes: Part of Yeperenye / Emily and Jessie Gaps Nature Park; free entry, open daily 24 hours (Tourism NT). Traditional owners ask visitors not to climb the rocks or photograph the rock art. Tourism NT says 10-14 km from town; pin is 9 km straight line.

alice-springs-6.name: Royal Flying Doctor Service Tourist Facility
alice-springs-6.bio: Original 1939 flying doctor base with a John Flynn hologram, virtual-reality flight and museum.
alice-springs-6.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 186250211 tourism=museum (RFDS Tourist Facility building), 90 m from Wikipedia of the RFDS museum point; MEDIUM.
alice-springs-6.notes: Renamed from "Royal Flying Doctor Service Base" to the facility's own name (id unchanged). No wiki: the RFDS article is the national organisation. The draft bio said it shares a complex with the School of the Air; that is not sourced (the facility is at 8-10 Stuart Terrace), so it was dropped. Adult 22 (Tourism NT). Closed 25 Dec and 1 Jan.

alice-springs-7.name: Old Ghan Heritage Railway and Museum
alice-springs-7.bio: Museum about the original Ghan railway, with a steam engine and historic carriages parked outside.
alice-springs-7.wiki: Old Ghan Heritage Railway and Museum
alice-springs-7.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 558236376 tourism=museum (Old Ghan Museum building); Wikipedia point 120 m away; MEDIUM.
alice-springs-7.notes: SAME SITE AND TICKET as alice-springs-12 (National Road Transport Museum): the museum's own site describes one tour that begins in the Old Ghan Museum and finishes in the truck halls. Owner may want to merge the two spots (photos and bios overlap). Adult 25 shared ticket (Tourism NT). The Mini Ghan train ride is under repair, so the draft bio's "heritage railway" ride is not offered. Closed 13 Dec 2026 to 11 Jan 2027 (TBC).

alice-springs-8.name: Olive Pink Botanic Garden
alice-springs-8.bio: Free arid-zone botanic garden with over 600 plant species, bushfood trails and a hill lookout over town.
alice-springs-8.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 225921853 leisure=garden (Olive Pink Botanic Garden), 60 m from Wikipedia (-23.7064,133.8849); MEDIUM.
alice-springs-8.notes: Closed Good Friday, Christmas Day and New Year's Day. Garden gate hours differ from the cafe's. Hill lookout is Tharrarletneme (Annie Meyers Hill), a registered sacred site.

alice-springs-9.name: Women's Museum of Australia
alice-springs-9.bio: Museum of Australian women's achievements, housed in the Old Gaol, whose buildings are included in the ticket.
alice-springs-9.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM; doors close 2:30 PM
alice-springs-9.coordinates_source: Wikipedia coordinates of the museum (-23.7041,133.8769); no OpenStreetMap feature exists for the Old Gaol. LOW: the Wikipedia article on the gaol itself is at -23.7031,133.877 (111 m away). Pin kept at the museum article's point, 107 m from the RFDS pin.
alice-springs-9.notes: pin: LOW (two Wikipedia points 111 m apart, no OSM feature); owner may verify on the map. Adult 20 (official site); 3-day pass available. Tourism NT lists the same Tue-Sat 10-3 hours.

alice-springs-10.name: Adelaide House
alice-springs-10.bio: 1926 stone hospital designed by John Flynn, now a small museum with a guided tour and tea.
alice-springs-10.hours: Mon, Tue, Thu and market Sundays 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM
alice-springs-10.coordinates_source: Wikipedia (-23.69955,133.88252) and the median of 5 geotagged Commons files (-23.699667,133.882778), 28 m apart; HIGH.
alice-springs-10.notes: UNVERIFIED hours: the church's own site says Mon, Tue, Thu and market Sundays 10-1, volunteer run, may close at short notice; Tourism NT lists only Thursday and Sunday 10-1. Price 5 adult (Tourism NT, includes tour and tea). The link is the operating church's homepage (no museum page was found).

alice-springs-11.name: Alice Springs Reptile Centre
alice-springs-11.bio: Over 100 reptiles in recreated habitats, with a saltwater crocodile viewed from underground and daily talks.
alice-springs-11.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 225563493 tourism=attraction (Alice Springs Reptile Centre), 9 Stuart Terrace; MEDIUM.
alice-springs-11.notes: Adult 24 and 9:30-5 daily from the centre's own plan-your-visit page (Tourism NT still shows 23 and shorter hours, out of date). Pin 111 m from the RFDS pin.

alice-springs-12.name: National Road Transport Museum
alice-springs-12.bio: Halls of vintage trucks, including Bertha, Australia's first road train, plus classic cars and a Wall of Fame.
alice-springs-12.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 558236375 tourism=museum (National Road Transport Hall of Fame); 135 m from the Old Ghan pin; MEDIUM.
alice-springs-12.notes: Same site and ticket as alice-springs-7 (see its notes). Museum asks for about 1.5 hours. Temporary closures: see site (13/10/26 storm repairs; Christmas break 13 Dec 2026 to 11 Jan 2027, TBC).

east-macdonnell-ranges-1.name: Trephina Gorge Nature Park
east-macdonnell-ranges-1.bio: Quartzite gorge lined with river red gums, with short walks, waterholes and the largest ghost gum in Central Australia.
east-macdonnell-ranges-1.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 2355811794 amenity=shelter + tourism=information at the Trephina Gorge day-use area (car park 15 m away, Trephina Gorge Walk start 45 m); MEDIUM.
east-macdonnell-ranges-1.notes: Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass (10 adult per day; NT residents exempt) as stated on the Tourism NT page; camping fees extra, booked online. Sealed Ross Highway then 9 km (last 5 km gravel). John Hayes Rockhole is 4WD only. Park page not loadable by script.

east-macdonnell-ranges-2.name: Arltunga Historical Reserve
east-macdonnell-ranges-2.bio: Central Australia's first town, a gold-rush site 110 km east of Alice Springs, with restored stone buildings.
east-macdonnell-ranges-2.hours: Reserve 24 hours; visitor centre 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
east-macdonnell-ranges-2.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 3797249213 tourism=information (Arltunga Visitor Centre); MEDIUM. The reserve centroid (-23.4498,134.7159) was not used.
east-macdonnell-ranges-2.notes: NT Parks Visitor Pass applies (Tourism NT page); Roadtrippers shows it as free, so owner may want to confirm. 33 km of the road in is gravel. Visitor centre hours from the NT Parks page snippet.

east-macdonnell-ranges-3.name: Corroboree Rock
east-macdonnell-ranges-3.bio: Dark grey dolomite column sacred to the Eastern Arrernte, with a short walk around its base off the Ross Highway.
east-macdonnell-ranges-3.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 3020052566 natural=peak (Corroboree Rock) and node 879931118 tourism=viewpoint 69 m away, plus way 226848198 natural=cliff; HIGH.
east-macdonnell-ranges-3.notes: UNVERIFIED hours: no source states them (Tourism NT omits). Registered sacred site: stay on the marked track. NT Parks Visitor Pass applies per Tourism NT page; the nt.gov.au page is at /corroboree-rock-conservation-area (found via search, not loaded). Placement name kept as "Corroboree Rock"; wiki is the reserve article.

east-macdonnell-ranges-4.name: N'Dhala Gorge Nature Park
east-macdonnell-ranges-4.bio: Gorge protecting about 6,000 rock engravings along a 1.5 km walking track, reached only by 4WD.
east-macdonnell-ranges-4.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node 8285265914 tourism=information (N'Dhala Gorge Information) at the walk start, inside the park boundary and beside the N'Dhala Gorge Walk; MEDIUM.
east-macdonnell-ranges-4.notes: Walk is 1.5 km, 1 hour return. About 11 km of 4WD track beyond Ross River Homestead that crosses the Ross River and floods. NT Parks Visitor Pass applies (Tourism NT page); camping is bush camping, bring water. Placement draft said 'by 4WD or dirt track'; sources say 4WD only.

destination.name: Alice Springs
destination.tagline: The Red Centre's hub among the MacDonnell Ranges, with a desert wildlife park, a telegraph station and sacred gaps on its doorstep.
destination.description: Alice Springs (Mparntwe) sits among the MacDonnell Ranges in the middle of Australia and is the base for the Red Centre. The town grew around the 1872 Overland Telegraph Station, which can still be visited, and its museums cover the Flying Doctor, The Ghan railway and the road trains. A hilltop memorial, a botanic garden and the sacred gaps of the Heavitree Range are minutes from the centre, and the Desert Park shows the region's wildlife. The East and West MacDonnell Ranges are reached by road from here.
whyVisit: Look over town from Anzac Hill

goodToKnow.title: Check opening days
goodToKnow.detail: Several museums close on set days: the Women's Museum is shut Sunday and Monday, and the Road Transport Museum is shut Saturday.

goodToKnow.title: Hot days, cold nights
goodToKnow.detail: Summer days are very hot and winter nights can fall below freezing. Plan walks for early morning and pack layers in winter.

goodToKnow.title: Respect sacred sites
goodToKnow.detail: At Emily Gap, traditional owners ask visitors not to climb the rocks or photograph the rock art. Follow signs at other sites.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The cooler months, {months}, bring mild days and cold nights that suit walking and day trips; summer is very hot.

destinations.notes: Centre is OSM place=city node 29341070 (Alice Springs). Order kept as placed; arguably Emily Gap (Tourism NT top-ten stop) could move above Anzac Hill, and alice-springs-7 and -12 are one site/ticket (see their notes). Span 30 km holds all spots (farthest 9 km). Museum of Central Australia is closed and is not mentioned.

destination.name: East MacDonnell Ranges
destination.tagline: Gorges, rock engravings and a gold-rush ghost town along the Ross Highway east of Alice Springs.
destination.description: The East MacDonnell Ranges stretch about 150 km east of Alice Springs along the Ross Highway, with gaps, gorges, bush walks and Aboriginal art. The road is sealed for the first 75 km, to Trephina Gorge, so Corroboree Rock and Trephina can be a day trip in an ordinary car. Beyond that, N'Dhala Gorge's rock engravings need a four-wheel drive, and the road to the Arltunga ruins includes 33 km of gravel. Camping is available in the parks, and Ross River Resort has cabins and sites 80 km east of town.
whyVisit: See rock engravings at N'Dhala Gorge

goodToKnow.title: Sealed road ends at Trephina
goodToKnow.detail: The Ross Highway is sealed for about 75 km. N'Dhala Gorge needs a high-clearance 4WD and the Arltunga road has 33 km of gravel.

goodToKnow.title: Parks pass required
goodToKnow.detail: Visitors need an NT Parks Visitor Pass for these parks, from $10 a day; NT residents are exempt. Camping is booked online beforehand.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The cooler months, {months}, are best for the walks and the 4WD tracks; summer is very hot and rain can close the creek crossings.

destinations.notes: Name confirmed by Tourism NT destination page northernterritory.com/alice-springs-and-surrounds/destinations/east-macdonnell-ranges (loaded OK; WebSearch also lists it): it describes the East Macs stretching 150 km east and lists Trephina, Corroboree Rock, N'Dhala, Arltunga, Ruby Gap and Emily/Jessie Gaps. Centre is Ross River Resort (OSM node 3797249212 tourism=motel, -23.59306,134.494098), the Ross Highway base at about 80 km, not any spot pin (6 km from N'Dhala, 13 km from Trephina). All four spots lie within 30 km of the centre (limit 45 km). Order kept as placed.
